set -eu
MAC=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
TARGET=fbeefb174c309a252e82b47b20dbe3bf63217485
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
SSH="ssh -i $KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10"
test -r "$KEY"
test -z "$(git -C "$MAC" status --porcelain=v1)"
cd "$MAC"
git fetch --no-tags origin main
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$TARGET"
git switch -C agent-work refs/remotes/origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
cd frontend
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
test -f dist/index.html
printf 'MAC_BUILD_SHA=%s\n' "$TARGET"
printf 'MAC_INDEX_SHA256=%s\n' "$(shasum -a 256 dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
cd ..
$SSH "$PI" '
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = ac898d465bfca86d4259cdf76abea1dadb2e1f4c
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
test -f backend/data/app.db
test -f frontend/dist/index.html
backup=.dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre
if [ -e "$backup" ]; then echo BACKUP_DIRECTORY_ALREADY_EXISTS; exit 4; fi
mkdir -p "$backup/frontend"
python3 - "$backup" <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import sqlite3,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
src=sqlite3.connect("file:backend/data/app.db?mode=ro",uri=True)
dst=sqlite3.connect(str(root/"app-before.sqlite"))
src.backup(dst)
assert dst.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok"
for table in ("place","photo","memory"):
 print("PROD_BACKUP_"+table.upper(),dst.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0])
dst.close();src.close()
print("PROD_SQLITE_BACKUP_INTEGRITY=ok")
PY
cp -a frontend/dist/. "$backup/frontend/"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$backup/previous-main-sha.txt"
printf "PROD_PRE_HEAD=%s\n" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf "PROD_BACKUP_ROOT=%s\n" "$backup"
printf "PROD_BACKUP_INDEX_SHA256=%s\n" "$(sha256sum "$backup/frontend/index.html" | awk "{print \$1}")"
printf "PROD_REPO_ORIGIN=%s\n" "$(git remote get-url origin)"
'
echo PHOTOMAP_MAC_BUILD_PI_BACKUP_READY
